purpose: Global API contracts plus one stable offline database for all users and tasks.

design_contract.single_source_of_truth: All users must use API definitions from this folder.
design_contract.interface_stability: The same api_name always has the same function signature, parameter schema, return schema, and preference-sensitive parameter markers.
design_contract.input_output_format: All callable APIs use JSON object arguments and JSON object responses.
design_contract.database_stability: The offline database is shared globally. User-specific sandbox folders are not used.
design_contract.runtime_personalization: Personalization is applied by evaluator prompts and SandboxExecutor using user profile/history plus global database records, not by per-user API schemas.
